Release 50% advance compensation from company reserve if underwriter is stalled
Update customer weekly with claims tracking log
prohibited_actions: Leave customer waiting without tracking or insurance updates

rule_matrix.conditions: Insurance payout withheld for enterprise cargo loss exceeding PKR 500,000

Provide corporate client daily status briefings from executive office
Execute bridge settlement if liability is contractually clear
prohibited_actions: Default on enterprise cargo commitments

rule_matrix.conditions: Customer reports courier sent unsolicited personal message on WhatsApp after delivery
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Direct violation of customer data privacy and contact masking policy

Block courier from customer contact details permanently
Issue formal disciplinary reprimand and safety retraining
prohibited_actions: Disclose customer home address to courier during investigation
Downplay unwanted contact as harmless

rule_matrix.conditions: Merchant manifests containing 500+ customer names and phone numbers leaked online or sent to wrong client
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Massive PII data breach mandates immediate critical management and compliance escalation
required_actions: Execute emergency containment and take down exposed URL / file links
Notify Chief Information Security Officer and Legal Counsel within 1 hour
Issue formal statutory breach disclosure and notify affected data subjects
prohibited_actions: Conceal data breach from impacted customers and regulators
Delete audit logs to obscure breach origin

rule_matrix.conditions: Customer requests permanent deletion / erasure of shipping history under privacy rights
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Statutory data retention and erasure request; standard legal compliance workflow
required_actions: Verify requester identity and CNIC credentials
Purge PII from marketing databases while retaining tax-mandated 24-month invoices
Issue formal Data Privacy Certificate of Erasure
prohibited_actions: Delete active taxation invoices before mandatory 24-month statutory period

rule_matrix.conditions: Customer requests opt-out from promotional broadcast SMS marketing campaigns
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Standard marketing unsubscribe request; low priority automated workflow

Send automated opt-out confirmation message within 24 hours
prohibited_actions: Continue sending promotional SMS to opted-out numbers

rule_matrix.conditions: Customer receives spam SMS originating from rogue third-party claiming to be company partner
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Brand spoofing and potential phishing attack targeting delivery recipients

rule_matrix.conditions: Enterprise client alleges unauthorized marketing outreach to their confidential customer list
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Contractual non-solicitation breach and major corporate trust violation

Terminate third-party marketing vendor contract if unauthorized scraping occurred
Provide enterprise client with full forensic compliance report
prohibited_actions: Deny cross-marketing without conducting audit of marketing data sources

rule_matrix.conditions: Citizen reports courier van driving recklessly / speeding in residential neighborhood
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Public safety hazard requires immediate telematics review regardless of whether accident occurred
required_actions: Retrieve vehicle GPS telematics and speed-monitoring logs
Identify driver and issue formal safety warning and speeding deduction
Send acknowledgement and appreciation note to reporting citizen
prohibited_actions: Ignore reckless driving report if no physical damage was done

rule_matrix.conditions: Company delivery vehicle involved in road traffic accident resulting in property damage
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Traffic collision involving third-party property damage requires emergency P0 response
required_actions: Dispatch regional safety response officer to accident site immediately
Arrange alternative vehicle to secure customer parcels and resume transit
Coordinate with local traffic authorities and insurance adjusters
prohibited_actions: Flee accident scene or conceal vehicle involvement
Abandon cargo at accident scene

rule_matrix.conditions: Severe fleet collision involving bodily injury or fatality
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Catastrophic human safety emergency mandates highest level executive crisis management
required_actions: Activate Emergency Executive Crisis Response Team
Ensure immediate medical care and hospital coordination for injured parties
Brief Chief Executive Officer and General Legal Counsel within 30 minutes
prohibited_actions: Issue public statements without legal clearance
Attempt informal off-record settlement

rule_matrix.conditions: Hub staff identifies parcel emitting pungent odor / small non-toxic cosmetic liquid leak
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Minor contained spill; standard hazardous isolation and repacking protocol
required_actions: Isolate parcel in ventilated hub containment bay
Inspect contents wearing protective gloves and eye protection
Repack undamaged items and notify sender of leakage disposal
prohibited_actions: Allow leaking parcel to continue onto conveyor belts
Throw away entire consignment without notifying shipper

rule_matrix.conditions: Consignment of undeclared lithium batteries catches fire / emits smoke in regional sortation center
rule_matrix.priority_logic_note: Active fire hazard threatening personnel and facility mandates emergency P0 escalation
required_actions: Evacuate sorting floor and deploy specialized chemical fire extinguishers
Isolate affected cargo container in outdoor fire-safe zone
Notify fire department and initiate emergency investigation against shipper
prohibited_actions: Attempt to handle smoking lithium batteries with bare hands
Resume sortation before safety clearance

rule_matrix.conditions: Commercial freight shipment found to contain undeclared toxic industrial chemicals / acids

Report illegal hazardous transit to Environmental Protection Agency and Police
Blacklist shipper account across all national booking terminals
prohibited_actions: Release toxic chemicals back to shipper without regulatory clearance

rule_matrix.conditions: Inter-provincial consignment missing commercial invoice copy in outer pouch; digital copy on file

Attach reprint to parcel documentation pouch at transit hub
Authorize shipment release for next linehaul departure
prohibited_actions: Hold shipment indefinitely when digital invoice is verified on file
